name: dcc
description: Kerchanshe Group Digital Communications Control Center (DCC)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @dcc/contracts && npm run build -w @dcc/operational-engine && npm run build -w @dcc/api && npm run build -w @dcc/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @dcc/contracts && npm run build -w @dcc/operational-engine
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @dcc/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @dcc/operational-engine && npm run typecheck -w @dcc/api && npm run typecheck -w @dcc/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @dcc/contracts && npm run test -w @dcc/operational-engine && npm run test -w @dcc/api
scripts.db:reset: node scripts/db/bootstrap.mjs --reset && npm run db:migrate -w @dcc/api && npm run db:seed -w @dcc/api
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build:packages && npm run infra:up && npm run db:bootstrap && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
